title: Service flows and observed workload
window: Entry and exit window: seven rolling days, start included and end excluded.
excluded: Excluded dossiers without a qualified agreement:
cycle: Creation → evidence for exits, median / P95:
cohortHelp: Unique services by channel, target, format, current observed mode and deadline availability.
definition: Each service counts once, including collective deliveries. Exits use currently qualified evidence, never simulations or waivers. This snapshot can change when evidence is corrected. Age since creation measures neither stage waiting time nor human work. P95 uses the nearest upper rank; no value without a sample.
unavailable: Flow measurement unavailable or not provided. No zero is inferred.
humanHelp: To establish your baseline, choose an activity and start the timer while working on it. It pauses when you leave the tab or window. Resume manually.
consent: I want to measure this session, only on this page.
humanLimits: Local measurement with no storage or transmission. Cleared when leaving the page or changing dossier or session. Self-reported time does not prove continuous attention or establish autonomy, human capacity or measured gains. Visits and sessions are not converted into working time.
aggregateHelp: Period entries and exits · observed aggregates
